scope: Core structures; compatible combinations still require show/sport context validation.

families.name: Outlast / placement draft
families.description: A drafted team scored by placement; supports reversed placement and compatible draft/ranking modifiers.

families.name: Lineups, best ball and scored rosters
families.description: Drafted moment- or sports-stat scoring: selected starters, automatically selected best N, or a whole sports roster. Also the home for compatible objectives, captain, category and market variants.

families.name: Survival pools and weekly participant picks
families.description: One survival pick per episode, or one/multiple fresh picks scored by show moments. Lives, streaks and points apply only where their spec is compatible.

families.name: Weekly Calls
families.description: The show-specific recurring calls, counted by their specialized grading flow.

families.name: Weekly Bingo
families.description: Episode cards graded by completed bingo lines.

families.name: Prediction / answer games
families.description: Arbitrary compatible question sheets, including sports winner/slate picks, brackets, trivia, confidence/chip/pair controls and player-built tickets.

families.name: Multi-stage / hybrid games
families.description: Compose supported child games sequentially or alongside each other, with overall scoring; compatible stage rules can follow format changes or other seasons/shows.

families.name: Sports squares
families.description: Hold squares on a two-team score-digit grid; the relevant period/halftime/final score pays the winning square.

wizardBases.name: Weekly Lineup
wizardBases.description: Draft a roster and choose the starters that count each episode.

wizardBases.name: Best Ball
wizardBases.description: Draft a roster; the engine automatically counts the best N each episode. No manual lineup.

wizardBases.name: Outlast
wizardBases.description: Draft a team; every holding scores by how long it lasts. Reversed placement scoring is an optional variation.

wizardBases.name: Prediction Sheet
wizardBases.description: Answer a configurable sheet of predictions; questions can use any compatible answer/settlement controls.

wizardBases.name: Weekly Picks
wizardBases.description: Pick one or several participants afresh each episode and score what they do. This is distinct from drafting a roster.

wizardBases.name: Survival Pool
wizardBases.description: Pick one participant per episode to survive or meet the game’s scoring condition; track a streak, points or lives.

wizardBases.name: Weekly Calls
wizardBases.description: Play the show’s specialized recurring two-call format. This is distinct from arbitrary prediction questions.

wizardBases.name: Weekly Bingo
wizardBases.description: Play an episode bingo card; completed lines score.

sports.name: Season roster / lineup league
sports.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head each week.

sports.name: Short draft / whole-roster game
sports.about: One game, a series or a team's next few: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.

sports.name: Winner / sports pick’em predictions
sports.about: Each game, before it starts: who wins? A point for each one right, most points wins (a tie counts for nobody).

sports.name: Pick several athletes in a stat prediction
sports.about: Each game, before it starts: pick three players. 3 points for each one who has the most total bases in the game (tied, each of them), most points wins.
